content.subject: Quick question about payment reconciliation
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. We help operations teams automate manual, reconciliation-heavy processes.

Saw that Episode Six raised $48M to streamline payment processes. I imagine keeping payment ledgers and bank reconciliations aligned across multiple systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We extract transaction data from source systems, match it against ledger entries, and flag mismatches, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
